name: agentic-workspace
description: Local Electron desktop workspace for coordinating AI CLI agents across projects.

scripts.test: npm run typecheck && npm run test:workflows
scripts.test:workflows: node --no-warnings --experimental-sqlite --import ./tests/support/register.mjs --test tests/workflow-repository.test.ts tests/workflow-approval.test.ts tests/workflow-schedule.test.ts tests/workflow-ref-trigger.test.ts tests/workflow-agent-binding.test.ts tests/workflow-metrics.test.ts tests/workflow-ui.test.ts tests/shell-navigation.test.ts tests/desktop-database.test.ts tests/database-migrations.test.ts tests/log-retention.test.ts tests/git-service.test.ts tests/task-automation.test.ts tests/task-retry-policy.test.ts tests/task-planner-availability.test.ts tests/task-ai-planner.test.ts tests/settings-service.test.ts tests/provider-connection-honesty.test.ts tests/knowledge-service.test.ts tests/knowledge-alias.test.ts tests/knowledge-progress.test.ts tests/knowledge-incremental.test.ts tests/knowledge-ast.test.ts tests/knowledge-search.test.ts tests/agent-path-env.test.ts tests/structured-chat.test.ts tests/diagnostics.test.ts tests/diagnostics-gateway.test.ts tests/provider-runtime-env.test.ts tests/agent-process-lifecycle.test.ts tests/process-kill-escalation.test.ts tests/agent-spawn-failure.test.ts tests/rendered-html.test.mjs
scripts.verify:agents: rolldown scripts/agent-backend-harness.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron -d .verify && node --experimental-sqlite --no-warnings .verify/agent-backend-harness.js
scripts.verify:agents:proc: rolldown scripts/agent-process-harness.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron -d .verify && node --experimental-sqlite --no-warnings .verify/agent-process-harness.js
scripts.verify:agents:chat: rolldown scripts/agent-chat-harness.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron -d .verify && node --experimental-sqlite --no-warnings .verify/agent-chat-harness.js
scripts.verify:agents:ui: vite build --config vite.renderer.config.ts --outDir "$PWD/.verify/renderer" --emptyOutDir && rolldown src/preload/preload.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron -d .verify && rolldown scripts/agent-e2e-harness.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron -d .verify && AGENTIC_RENDERER_DIR="$PWD/.verify/renderer" AGENTIC_PRELOAD="$PWD/.verify/preload.js" AGENTIC_OUT_DIR="$PWD/.verify" electron .verify/agent-e2e-harness.js
scripts.verify:tasks:ui: vite build --config vite.renderer.config.ts --outDir "$PWD/.verify/renderer" --emptyOutDir && rolldown src/preload/preload.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron -d .verify && rolldown scripts/task-navigation-harness.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron -d .verify && AGENTIC_RENDERER_DIR="$PWD/.verify/renderer" AGENTIC_PRELOAD="$PWD/.verify/preload.js" AGENTIC_OUT_DIR="$PWD/.verify" electron .verify/task-navigation-harness.js
scripts.verify:settings:ui: vite build --config vite.renderer.config.ts --outDir "$PWD/.verify/renderer" --emptyOutDir && rolldown src/preload/preload.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron -d .verify && rolldown scripts/settings-providers-harness.ts --format cjs --platform node --external electron -d .verify && AGENTIC_RENDERER_DIR="$PWD/.verify/renderer" AGENTIC_PRELOAD="$PWD/.verify/preload.js" AGENTIC_OUT_DIR="$PWD/.verify" electron .verify/settings-providers-harness.js
